feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: We are still puzzling over the mysteries of Edgar Allan Poe and Arthur Conan Doyle
entry.summary: Both Poe and Doyle have generated mountains of literary criticism over the years, but Darkness Becomes Bright and Sleuth-Hound remind us there's a lot left to discover about these masters.

entry.title: Thick smog shrouds New Delhi after Diwali firecrackers add to seasonal pollution
entry.summary: New Delhi, home to over 30 million people, regularly ranks among the world's most polluted areas during winter, with pollution worsening in late October and November.

entry.title: British comedian Russell Brand sentenced to over 10 years for rape and sexual assault
entry.summary: Russell Brand, who became a celebrity darling in the early 2000s, was found guilty on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault in a case brought by six women.

entry.title: Why a South Korean city is turning to a U.S. college to outsmart AI?
entry.summary: Through civic participation and liberal education, South Korean educators hope to "quietly stitch the fabric of our democracy…before it unravels beyond repair."

entry.title: Democrats won big on issues like immigration. But ICE still has the money
entry.summary: Following Tuesday's "blue wave," Democrats have vowed to reign in ICE's power. What could they actually accomplish?

entry.title: On wild Cumberland Island, a land swap proposal stirs controversy
entry.summary: Visitors, ecologists, park rangers and residents all love this wild barrier island off the coast of southern Georgia. But they have different ideas of how to best protect it.

entry.title: He was diagnosed with cancer. Then he was told he lost his Medicaid
entry.summary: Health clinics and organizations advocating for poor and working-class Nebraskans say the rollout of Medicaid work requirements has been rife with problems.

entry.title: U.N. climate talks begin today. Here are 3 things to know
entry.summary: Countries are gathering in Antalya, Turkey, for the annual U.N. climate conference. Many are frustrated with the lack of focus on fossil fuels, the main driver of climate change.

entry.title: Supreme Court weighs effort to shield federal law enforcement as ICE complaints rise
entry.summary: The Supreme Court considers the case of a prisoner who suffered brutal injuries, only to be denied medical care behind bars. He wants to sue the prison nurse in a case that could change the law on holding federal officers accountable.

entry.title: Democrats won big. Can they lower your grocery bill?
entry.summary: Affordability concerns were top of mind for voters heading into the midterms, as tariffs and the war in Iran drove up prices, including food costs. Now, Americans are expecting relief from Washington.
